description: A React component for the main page of a ToDo application, managing todo list display, filtering, searching, and CRUD interactions.

methods.name: TodosPage
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the ToDo page, manages state for filters, search query, loading, todos, and error handling, and fetches todos from API.

methods.name: fetchTodos
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch todos from the API based on current filter and search query, handles loading state and errors.
